sources.scope: 2026–2027 OER Arts. 3.2, 3.3, 3.5 and Appendices 1–3, 6 and 7. Controls language, major, credits, both packages, profiling and successor codes.
Current programme identity and music-centered aims.
Official foundation and depth content, course interests, listening and applications, and 45 EC binding advice threshold.
2026 entrant schedule, 120/60 split and Year 3 thesis preparation.
2026–2027 seminar entry: 22.5 EC at level 3; musicological methods and proposal.
2026–2027 thesis entry: successful research seminar. Planner carries predecessor code, whose successor is explicit in OER Appendix 6.

curriculum: This full-time Dutch-taught BA allows some English instruction. The 120 EC major consists of two 30 EC foundations, compulsory philosophy and research seminar (7.5 EC each), one 30 EC advanced depth package, one restricted context course (7.5 EC), and the standard 7.5 EC thesis. The longer 15 EC thesis is an alternative offset by 7.5 fewer free profiling credits. Official order selects Music and Society and Art, Culture and Society without consulting UCR fit. Four depth courses, seminar and thesis give 45 EC at level 3. The 60 EC profiling block includes a coherent 30 EC package and 30 EC remaining electives, illustrated as two 15 EC slots. Eligible external or nonstandard choices may need prior approval.
progression: Year 1 completes the two foundation packages, with positive study advice normally requiring 45 EC. Year 2 uses the four depth courses across Blocks 1–4, with the context choice in Block 1, philosophy in Block 2 and profiling in Blocks 3 and 4. The four depth courses provide 30 advanced EC before the Year 3 research seminar, exceeding the 22.5 EC entry threshold. Year 3 uses the seminar in Block 1 and thesis in Block 2, with the remaining profiling in Blocks 3 and 4. The thesis catalogue names predecessor MC3V14002. The 2026–2027 OER Appendix 6 maps it explicitly to MU3V26003. No compulsory internship is shown.
